title: Account Based Marketing Executive
description:
Account Based Marketing Market Research Executive
Salary: 30,000 dependant on experience plus bonus and other Veolia benefits
Hours: 40 hours per week
Location:Hybrid working in our Cannock office
When you see the world as we do, you see the chance to help the world take better care of its resources and help it become a better place for everyone. It's why we're looking for someone who's just as committed as we are, to push for genuine change and bring our ambition of Ecological Transformation to life.

We know that everyone here at Veolia can help us work alongside our communities, look after the environment and contribute to our inclusive culture.
What we can offer you:
- 25 days of annual leave
- Access to our company pension scheme
- Discounts on everything from groceries to well known retailers
- Access to a range of resources to support your physical, mental and financial health; so you can lean on us whenever you need to
- One paid days leave every year to volunteer and support your community
- Ongoing training and development opportunities, allowing you to reach your full potential
- Stream - Employee financial wellbeing support: early access to your earned pay, savings, budgeting, financial coaching & rewards.

Key responsibilities:
- Accountable for supporting the ABM Manager in the delivery of the ABM strategy.
- Conduct comprehensive research of high-value target accounts, key stakeholders, competition and the offering to ensure communication resonates with the right decision makers.
- Develop in-depth insights reports for key accounts including comprehensive stakeholder mapping and individual persona development.
- Prepare research recommendations and strategic insights for campaign development.
- Work with the communications to utilise media resonance and social listening tools to gather insights for ABM campaigns.
- Support in the execution of multi-channel ABM campaigns across current marketing automation software. Utilising full Marketing tech stack.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including wider marketing, business development, policy and technical to ensure alignment and maximise the impact of ABM initiatives. Ensuring the alignment of messaging, content and delivery channels, as well as managing expectations of projects and working to a deadline to support the team and wider business.
- Responsible for relationship building and nurturing across target accounts to deliver marketing qualified contacts.
- Ensuring all Marketing generated data is managed legally and appropriately
- Ownership of personal development plan to self-develop in marketing and professional skills, ensuring you are keeping on top of your specialism and up-to-date on prospect news and new trends in the marketing industry.
- Responsible for establishing relationships across the business units that ABM directly links into
- Responsible for becoming a key point of contact for wider stakeholders outside of senior leadership teams
- Responsible for developing progressive rapport with designated business development leads
- Responsible for keeping on top of sector trends and developing relationships with customers when marketing opportunities arise
- Responsible for GDPR managed data to utilise in campaigns

What we're looking for;
- Marketing experience, preferably in a B2 B environment - essential
- Proven track record of cross-functional working - essential
- Integrated marketing - essential
- Market Research - essential
- Market intelligence and competitive analysis - essential
- Research methodology and insights driven generation - essential
- Stakeholder mapping - essential
- Project management - desirable
- Account management - desirable
- Salesforce & Marketing Cloud experience - desirable
- Brand marketing - desirable

What's next?

Apply today, so we can make a difference for generations to come.

We're proud to have been named as one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for three consecutive years in 2023, 2024 and 2025. This consistent recognition reflects our commitment to our people, demonstrating that Veolia is not just transforming the environment, we're also transforming what it means to have a rewarding, purposeful career.

We're dedicated to supporting you throughout your application journey, offering adjustments where reasonable and appropriate. As a proud Disability Confident Employer, we will offer an interview to applicants with a disability or long-term condition who opt-in to the Disability Confident scheme, and meet the minimum criteria for our roles.

We're also committed to ensuring that all applicants and colleagues receive fair treatment without discrimination on any grounds, aiming to create a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

title: Administration Assistant & Social media

description:
Administrative Assistant with Social Media & Advertising

Prime Space Midlands Ltd

Research and purchasing

No two days will be the same, and this role is suitable for someone who enjoys variety and wants more responsibility than a traditional administrative position.

Skills

Desirable

title: Marketing Executive
company: Work Lyf Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:

30,000 - 36,000 per annum

Location

Apply Now

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager

We are looking for an experienced Marketing Manager to join our creative agency and work across a small number of luxury lifestyle clients in the outdoor living sector.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the bigger picture but is just as comfortable getting into the detail. You will take responsibility for the day-to-day marketing of our clients, from planning campaigns and writing copy to posting and engaging on social, setting up photoshoots, managing all channels of customer communication and keeping a close eye on what is working.

You will be naturally organised, commercially minded and comfortable managing lots of moving parts. You will enjoy solving creative problems, finding ways to make things happen and seeing projects through to the end.

You ll be familiar with a range of marketing systems and software, including Mailchimp, Meta, WordPress, CRM and analytics tools.

What you'll be doing
- Taking ownership of marketing activity and keeping activity moving against agreed plans and targets.
- Planning and delivering campaigns across social, email, website, content, PR, paid media and other relevant channels.
- Writing clear, engaging, on brand copy for social, email, websites, campaigns and marketing materials.
- Planning and managing marketing collateral, making sure the right things are produced at the right time.
- Managing website content, ensuring information is accurate and content is current and relevant.
- Creating and managing social content, including posting, scheduling and engaging with audiences.
- Monitoring performance and reporting on activity against agreed targets, using results to inform what happens next.
- Working with a paid media specialist to keep them informed of wider marketing activity, ensure campaigns are aligned with overall objectives and contribute to making paid media activity as effective as possible. You should be confident working with the numbers, asking the right questions and understanding how paid media fits into the wider marketing mix.
- Planning photoshoots and managing collaborations, from briefing through to making sure the resulting assets are properly stored and used.
- Managing image libraries and content systems so that useful assets can be easily found and shared across the wider team.
- Developing practical processes and systems that make marketing activity easier to manage and more effective.
- Working closely with the Marketing Director, with support from the wider team, to anticipate what clients need, identify opportunities and come up with ideas.
- Building strong relationships with clients and becoming someone they can rely on to keep their marketing moving.
- Attending client meetings and events off site when required. Some projects may involve working outside normal office hours or occasional overnight stays.

What we're looking for

You will be an experienced marketeer - ideally with at least 5 years experience in a similar role - who is comfortable taking responsibility rather than waiting to be told what to do. You will understand how the different parts of the marketing mix work together and be able to move easily between strategic thinking and getting things done.

You'll be:
- Highly organised, with a good eye for detail; able to manage changing priorities without losing sight of the end goal, and with a habit of getting things finished.
- Commercially aware, able to understand what a business is trying to achieve and connect marketing activity to those goals.
- Creative and practical, able to come up with ideas but also work out how to make them happen.
- Confident with digital marketing, including social media, email, websites, analytics and paid media.
- Brand-conscious. You understand the importance of maintaining a strong, consistent brand across all marketing activity and will make sure that content, collateral and wider marketing decisions are appropriate for the brand and its audience.
- A good writer, able to adapt your tone and style for different brands and audiences.
- Comfortable with numbers, able to monitor results, spot what is and isn't working and explain this clearly.
- Resourceful and resilient, able to find a way forward when plans change or things don't go to plan.
- A confident communicator, comfortable dealing directly with clients and working with creative, marketing and specialist teams.
- A team player, generous with your knowledge and happy to get stuck in wherever needed.
- A self-starter, able to see what needs doing and get on with it. Know when to take something forward yourself, when to challenge an approach and when something needs to be referred to the Marketing Director.

Most importantly, you'll care about doing a good job. You'll be someone who notices the things others might miss, keeps people informed, takes ownership and doesn't let good ideas get stuck halfway.

The role

This is a full-time role with hybrid working, with at least three days a week based in our office in Staffordshire.

The role will also involve travelling to client meetings, shoots and events when required, with some projects occasionally requiring work outside normal office hours or overnight stays.

We're an intentionally small creative agency. Our team is close-knit and occasionally has a four-legged member of staff wandering around the office.

Salary: £36,000-£40,000

Annual leave: 20 days + 8 bank holidays

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager

Location: Staffordshire
Salary: Flexible DOE
Hours: 37.5 per week
B2 B Marketing Construction Landscaping Built Environment

Are you a B2 B marketer looking for a role where you can genuinely take ownership and have the freedom to shape how a business takes itself to market?

I'm working with a large, established landscaping business with a strong reputation across commercial landscaping, housing developments, grounds maintenance and horticulture.

They're looking for a Marketing Manager to take ownership of their B2 B marketing activity, working closely with the Managing Director and wider senior management team.

The Role

This is a hands-on role with plenty of variety.

You'll get out into the business, visit projects, work with operational teams and understand what clients are looking for - then turn that into marketing activity that raises the company's profile and supports both existing relationships and new business opportunities.

Day to day, you'll be involved in:
- Creating and managing B2 B content across LinkedIn, email and the website
- Visiting live and completed projects to gather content, photography and case studies
- Working with Contracts Managers and operational teams to understand upcoming projects
- Developing presentations, brochures, project sheets and sales collateral
- Supporting tenders, social value content and new business opportunities
- Managing email campaigns and the wider marketing calendar
- Supporting wider horticultural and nursery marketing activity
- Keeping the website and marketing materials up to date
- Working with senior management on marketing strategy and upcoming priorities
- Identifying opportunities to improve reach and strengthen the company's position in the market

There's already plenty happening across the business - they need someone who can find the stories worth telling and make sure they're reaching the right people.

About You

You'll need to be a proactive B2 B marketer who's comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting to be given a detailed brief.

You don't need to come directly from landscaping. Experience within construction, housebuilding, property, facilities management or another B2 B built-environment environment would be useful, but isn't essential.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous B2 B marketing experience
- Strong written and content creation skills
- Experience managing LinkedIn, websites and email marketing
- Practical graphic design capability, ideally Adobe InDesign and Canva
- The confidence to work directly with senior managers and operational teams
- A commercial mindset and an ability to spot opportunities
- Plenty of drive, creativity and initiative
- Full UK driving licence

We're open on level. You could already be operating as a Marketing Manager, or you may be a strong Senior Marketing Executive looking for the opportunity to step up and take more ownership.

Perks & Benefits
- 33 days' holiday including bank holidays
- Company pension
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Training and development
- Mileage reimbursement/pool vehicle for site visits
- Flexibility around start and finish times
- Some flexibility to work from home once established
- Direct exposure to senior management
- Plenty of autonomy to bring your own ideas to the role
- Genuine scope to develop the position and carve out your own role

This would suit someone who wants more than a narrow marketing role. You'll have the opportunity to get under the skin of the business, understand its clients and projects and have a genuine influence over how it's positioned in the market.

For more information or to apply, please contact Leo at MorePeople.
